narratives.author: claude
narratives.headline: Nine-game Friday, five props, all unders: Battle and Randle lead a Consider-grade board while injury reports are still open
narratives.briefing: It is a full nine-game Friday with nothing tipping before 2026-11-21T00:00Z, and the report's edge is again concentrated in player unders rather than game lines. Jamison Battle Under 3.5 rebounds (conviction 55) and Julius Randle Under 10.5 reb+ast (conviction 52) are the strongest cards, with the simulation landing under in 74% and 72% of runs; none of tonight's five props clears Consider, and Jalen Smith grades as a Pass. The morning report is 6-4-0 (+1.50u) with closing lines moving toward our morning picks 8 times and against 2, which is the more encouraging signal, but game lines are 13-30 (-18.41u) since 2026-11-11, so the five unders and the CLE spread below are leans only. This edition goes out before final injury reports: we are waiting on Cade Cunningham (probable), Trey Murphy III and Alperen Sengun (questionable), plus De'Andre Hunter and Andrew Nembhard. Any change there re-prices the affected cards on the next run.

cards.p|4431893|reb|Under: The model projects 2 rebounds against 3.5 and he has stayed under 2.5 in 7 of his last 10, so the line has cushion. The risk is role: with RJ Barrett out (Heavy reports a hamstring strain keeping him out at least two weeks) his minutes are projected up to 20.5, and his overs have come when he plays around 20 minutes. If the price runs past −111 or the line drops to 2.5, pass.
cards.p|3064514|ra|Under: A projection of 7.8 against 10.5 is the widest gap on the board, he has gone under in 5 of the last 5, and ORL ranks #6 toughest of 30 on small-forward reb+ast. What makes this wrong is minutes: his overs averaged 35.3 minutes and he is projected for 27.9, so a heavier load than expected is the main threat. We found no fresh injury or rest news on him this morning.
cards.p|4395628|reb|Under: The blowout risk on an 11.5-point spread and a 4.6 projection support the under at plus money. The case against is real: OKC is #6 softest of 30 for small-forward rebounds, he averaged 10.0 rebounds in 2 games against them, and only 4 of his last 10 went under. Trey Murphy III is listed day-to-day with a knee issue after missing Wednesday, and his status is a kill trigger for this card.
cards.p|4395651|ra|Under: The sim goes under in 75% of games and the projection is 4.9 against 6.5, with 7 of his last 10 under. The worry is the spot: he is 1 of 6 under against ATL, ATL games have +4% rebounds available, and Grayson Allen being out adds +1.9 minutes. Treat this as the most fragile of the Consider cards.
cards.p|4397189|reb|Under: This is a Pass at conviction 41: the projection of 7.3 is under 8.5, but WSH is the #1 softest of 30 for power-forward rebounds and similar players run +15% against them. The play-to is −101, the current price, so there is no room if it moves. We would stay off it unless the price improves.

narratives.leans_note: Four totals unders and CLE -7.5 are the sim's leans tonight, but game lines are 13-30 since 2026-11-11, so they are for tracking, not staking.
